units.name: Operations Research and Logistics Group (ORL)
units.evidence: Official full chair-group name and explicit quantitative supply-chain optimization, operations and logistics remit. The university-wide chair directory uses ORL; Business Science is the organizational section, not a business school. Education text explicitly names Wageningen University.

units.name: Business Management and Organisation Group
units.evidence: Official chair-group page names Strategic collaboration in supply chain networks as a research theme and explicitly studies sustainable supply-chain networks. This is a broader group with an established supply-chain remit, not a separately invented department.

units.name: Business Economics Group
units.evidence: Official chair-group page explicitly identifies Risk and Resilience in Agri-Food Supply Chains as one of three principal research themes and describes management problems within the food chain. Included for this substantive supply-chain remit, not economics alone.

decisions.reason: Current official chair-group name, actual organizational type and parent section verified; original label retained in provenance.

sources.note: Full group name, Wageningen University identity in education text, supply-chain optimization and operations remit.
University-wide inventory across all five departments; ORL acronym and Business Science hierarchy, with engineering groups checked separately.
Business Science explicitly described as a section. Management-group tab expanded to follow its official page.
Current chair group and explicit strategic supply-chain collaboration research theme.
Current chair group and explicit agri-food supply-chain risk/resilience research theme.
Engineering design, robotics, agricultural technologies and environmental production systems; no distinct industrial-engineering/operations remit established from this overview.
Physical food processing, ingredients, microtechnology and product properties; not relabeled as industrial engineering or operations management.

limitations: Business Economics and Business Management and Organisation are broad chair groups included for explicitly named supply-chain research themes. Physical process-engineering groups were examined but not added on the basis of generic process efficiency alone. Wageningen University is retained as the university identity rather than equating it with the full University & Research umbrella.
